artifact_staleness_audit.source_dependencies: data/datasets/*, data/entities/entities.seed.json, data/standards/*, data/relationships/relationships.seed.json (for projections); data/projections/tapping/*.json (for products)
artifact_staleness_audit.validators_compare_source_and_output: Only as of T13, and only for tap_drill.status specifically (projection vs. dataset). No validator compares HTML/CSV/client-data mtimes or checksums against their generator's source inputs to detect a stale-but-uncommitted-regeneration scenario.
artifact_staleness_audit.checksums_recorded: Only manually, per-phase, in audit documentation -- not mechanically enforced or stored as a build artifact.
artifact_staleness_audit.stale_output_scenario: If data/projections/tapping/tapping-profiles.json were hand-edited (or the knowledge layer changed and the projection generator not re-run) such that the projection and the HTML/CSV/client-data grew inconsistent with EACH OTHER, per-product validators would catch that (they compare HTML/CSV/client-data against the projection file, not against original source). But if the projection and ALL of its consumers were regenerated together from a stale/wrong knowledge-layer state, every validator would agree with every other validator while all being consistently wrong relative to true intent -- though T13's new check would still catch a stale relationship between dataset and projection specifically for tap_drill.status.
artifact_staleness_audit.tapping_specific_or_repo_wide: repo-wide -- confirmed no CI config, no build manifest, no source-checksum-to-artifact linkage exists anywhere in the repository, not just in the tapping domain.
artifact_staleness_audit.reason: Repo-wide infrastructure concern, not a bounded tapping-domain defect. Re-confirmed unchanged from T13's own conclusion -- no new evidence changes this; fixing it would mean build-system-level changes, explicitly out of scope per the phase brief's own framing.

findings.finding: Computed by generate-tapping-projections.js's summarizeDataQuality() and written into the projection, but confirmed via exhaustive grep to be read by ZERO consumers (no generator, product, or validator references 'data_quality_summary' anywhere). This is inert, unused computed data, not a trust-integrity risk -- since nothing reads it, a defect in its own internal correctness could never mislead a real user. Noted as a data-hygiene observation, not a T14 candidate (no user-visible failure mode exists).

Populated in the projection (standard.standard_status) but not rendered by any product. A derived boolean (Boolean(source_dataset && source_record && source_field)). Judged not to meet the same severity bar as the selected finding; not selected.

primary_finding.exact_source_signal: The same `const crossVerified = Boolean(hp.cross_verified);` computed once at the top of generate-tapping-projections.js's buildTapDrillBlock() and reused for FOUR separate output values: tap_drill.status (now derivation-tested by T13), tap_drill.convention (untested), tap_drill.provenance.source (untested), tap_drill.provenance.cross_check (untested).

derivation_rules.convention (metric only): crossVerified ? "ISO 2306 nominal-minus-pitch (BoltLab primary-source table match)" : "ISO 2306 nominal-minus-pitch (not independently cross-checked against the primary table)"

primary_finding.semantic_correctness_as_written: Same incompleteness as the status field T13 already fixed: `crossVerified` only checks presence of hp.cross_verified, never hp.cross_verified.match. If a future record ever had cross_verified present with match:false, these three fields would still claim 'primary-source table match' / cite a specific standard as the source / assert an exact match narrative -- all while T13's own check would correctly flag the status field as wrong, but nothing would flag these three sibling fields making the SAME false claim in prose.
primary_finding.evidence: Grep across scripts/validators/*.js for '.convention' (zero matches) and for 'cross_verified' (only the three lines inside T13's own status-only check) confirms no validator anywhere compares tap_drill.convention or provenance.source/cross_check against the source dataset.
primary_finding.current_live_data_note: All 9 currently-verified metric records have cross_verified.match:true, so their convention/provenance.source/provenance.cross_check text is factually accurate today. The risk, exactly as with T13's finding, is the absence of a regression guard -- not a live defect.

other_fields_reviewed_and_cleared.status: cleared -- derived from thread_system alone (UNF->fine, else coarse), which is definitionally correct since UNC/UNF series names themselves encode coarse/fine; not a genuine multi-source derivation risk, confirmed by the generator's own explanatory comment

known_documented_item_reconfirmed_not_re.item: downloads/tapping-atlas.csv's primary_drill_convention column reads 'ISO 2306 metric convention' for all 14 metric rows, including the 5 without individual cross-verification -- the same overclaim pattern T11 corrected in every HTML surface, deliberately NOT applied to the CSV.
known_documented_item_reconfirmed_not_re.status_at_time_of_t14: This is not a newly discovered risk. It was explicitly identified, reasoned through, and intentionally frozen by T11 under an explicit external regression-protection directive (the CSV was named a protected artifact that 'must not be altered' in that phase's own brief) -- documented in audit/t11-tapping-consistency.md/json under 'csv_protected_artifact_exception' and 'intentionally_unchanged'.
known_documented_item_reconfirmed_not_re.why_not_selected_for_t14: Selecting this as a T14 target would mean proposing to override a previous phase's explicit, deliberate, human-authorized constraint -- a materially different and more consequential kind of decision than adding a new validator check, and not something to unilaterally reopen absent new evidence that the original tradeoff was wrong. No such new evidence exists; the tradeoff's reasoning (grain/protection) still holds. Recorded here for visibility, not selected.

duplicated_data_audit.finding: No unsafe duplicated source of truth found. js/tapping-workflow-data.js is a generated build artifact (explicitly labeled as such in its own header comment: 'Do not hand-edit -- this is a build artifact, not an authored data source') that both tools/tapping-workflow.html and reference/tapping-evidence.html read from -- this is a LEGITIMATE static copy (one generated intermediate file feeding two consumers), not an unsafe duplication, since it is itself mechanically re-derivable from the projection and checked field-by-field against it. tools/tap-drill-calculator.html independently implements its own workshop-formula calculation (major diameter minus pitch) rather than reading the T3 projection at all -- this is a pre-existing, explicitly out-of-tapping-projection-scope design (confirmed in T11's audit: it doesn't claim verification status or reference BoltLab's verified dataset), not a duplicated-source-of-truth risk, since it never claims to be the same data.

cross_product_consistency_audit.spot_check_result: Projection tap_drill block, CSV row, and js/tapping-workflow-data.js's embedded tap_drill block for M8x1.0 are consistent: value=7mm, status=source_bound, convention narrative matches, provenance fields match (all null, correctly, since this record has no cross-verification). CSV's convention column correctly shows the frozen 'ISO 2306 metric convention' exception text as expected and documented.
cross_product_consistency_audit.broader_evidence: The full 29-record, all-4-product consistency claim rests primarily on the automated validator suite (T7-T13) rather than exhaustive manual spot-checking in this session -- consistent with how T11/T12/T13 each relied on their dedicated validators for this exact guarantee rather than re-deriving it by hand every phase.

selected_t14_target.title: Tap-Drill Convention and Cross-Check Narrative Source Derivation Verification
selected_t14_target.objective: Extend validate-tapping-projections.js's T13 derivation check to also independently re-derive and verify tap_drill.convention (metric rows) and tap_drill.provenance.{source,cross_check} against the source dataset's hole_preparation.cross_verified (using the same match-aware rule), closing the two sibling fields left uncovered when T13 fixed tap_drill.status alone.
selected_t14_target.root_risk: generate-tapping-projections.js's buildTapDrillBlock() computes ONE crossVerified boolean and reuses it for FOUR output fields; T13 verified only one of the four (status). The other three (convention, provenance.source, provenance.cross_check) share the identical incompleteness (presence-only, ignores .match) and have zero validator coverage.
selected_t14_target.source_of_truth: data/datasets/metric_tapping.seed.json, unc_tapping.seed.json, unf_tapping.seed.json -- each record's hole_preparation.cross_verified object (source/table/verified_date/match)
selected_t14_target.affected_consumers: data/projections/tapping/tapping-profiles.json (tap_drill.convention, tap_drill.provenance.source, tap_drill.provenance.cross_check); indirectly every downstream product that displays the convention label or cross-verification narrative
selected_t14_target.current_coverage: T13's check 10 covers tap_drill.status only; no check covers convention or provenance.source/cross_check
selected_t14_target.exact_gap: No validator compares tap_drill.convention's text, or provenance.source/cross_check's values, against a correct (match-aware) re-derivation from the source dataset
selected_t14_target.validator_behavior_required: For each of the 29 profiles, using the same match-aware crossVerified determination as T13's check, compute expectedConvention (metric rows only; non-metric rows always 'US customary drill-series' and are not at risk), expectedSource, and expectedCrossCheck, and fail if any disagrees with the projection's actual values.
selected_t14_target.mutation_test_required: Reuse the exact same mutation as T13 (flip an existing verified record's hole_preparation.cross_verified.match to false in a real, backed-up dataset file, without regenerating the projection); confirm the new check(s) fail with the expected mismatch identified; restore and confirm byte-identical checksum and pass.
selected_t14_target.false_positive_test_required: Run against the real, untouched data; must pass, 0 errors, since current data already satisfies the correct rule for all 3 fields.
selected_t14_target.regression_tests_required: All 9 existing tapping validators continue to pass; all projection/product/dataset checksums remain byte-identical (validator-only change, no generator or product edit needed).
selected_t14_target.determinism_requirements: Validator run 3x on restored real data; identical report checksum every run.
forbidden_files: all three tapping dataset seed files (except as a temporary, restored mutation-test fixture)
selected_t14_target.pass_criteria: 0 errors on real data; correct failure on the reproduced mismatch (all 3 fields, or however many are affected by the specific mutated record); all other validators unaffected; every checksum outside the validator itself unchanged

architecture_document_reason: The selected finding extends an existing validator behavior pattern (identical in shape to T13's own check) rather than establishing a new architectural rule.

implementation.check_added: Tap-Drill Convention and Cross-Check Narrative Correctly Derived From Source Cross-Verification
implementation.mechanism: For each of the 29 profiles, using the same match-aware isMatch determination as check 10: metric rows' tap_drill.convention must equal the correct match-aware text; non-metric rows' tap_drill.convention must equal the fixed 'US customary drill-series'; all rows' tap_drill.provenance.source and tap_drill.provenance.cross_check must equal crossVerified.source / the correct 'Matches {table} exactly (verified {date})' narrative when matched, else null.
